description: This file provides inline functions for mapping and checking I/O registers specific to the RTL838x chipset, defining internal logic for address region identification and memory mapping.

methods.name: int is_rtl838x_internal_registers(phys_addr_t offset)
methods.description: Checks if the given physical address offset falls within specific internal register regions for the RTL838x device.

methods.name: void __iomem * plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset,unsigned long size,unsigned long flags)
methods.description: Maps a physical address to an I/O memory region if it is identified as an internal register region; returns NULL otherwise.

methods.name: int plat_iounmap(const volatile void __iomem * addr)
methods.description: Checks whether an I/O memory address corresponds to internal registers, effectively unmapping it.

ctags.name: plat_ioremap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void __iomem *plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset, unsigned long size,$/
